lines.en: Let's study English together. Ask me a question.
lines.ko: 같이 영어 공부해요. 나한테 질문해 봐요.

lines.en: Okay. Who is your best friend, Grandma?
lines.ko: 네. 할머니, 가장 친한 친구는 누구예요?

lines.en: My best friend is your grandpa. What is next?
lines.ko: 가장 친한 친구는 네 할아버지예요. 다음은 뭐예요?

lines.en: Where did you meet him when you were young?
I met him at school when I was twenty.
Wow! Why do you like him?
Because he is kind. He never says no to me.
lines.ko: 친절하니까요. 나한테 절대 안 된다고 안 해요.

lines.en: Which question is next, Grandma?
That's all for today. Tomorrow we will study more.
lines.ko: 오늘은 여기까지예요. 내일 더 공부할 거예요.

lines.en: Sure! I'm sure you will do well.
Hello, Teacher. Where is my seat?
Please sit here. Do you know this word?
No, I don't know it. I'm not sure.
That's okay. Let's learn it together. Is it new?
lines.ko: 괜찮아요. 같이 배워요. 처음 보는 단어예요?

lines.en: Yes. I never saw it before today.
lines.ko: 네. 오늘 전에는 본 적이 없어요.

lines.en: Which word do you know? This one?
Yes! I learned that word last week.
Great. How do you say it?
Like this. Is that right?
Yes, that's right. You will learn fast.
